info.title: EduAI AI Service
info.description:
Service-to-service API over the EduAI runtime agent and ingestion pipeline.

Not public: the platform backend authenticates the end user, then calls this
service with the shared `x-service-token` secret.

post.summary: Answer a message from the syllabus
Answer a message, streaming stage-by-stage progress
post.description:
Server-sent events: a ``progress`` event per graph stage, then one
``result`` event carrying the same body as ``POST /ai/chat``.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Platform user id; scopes mastery reads and writes.

user_type.title: User Type
user_type.description: Determines the allowed tasks and the voice.

subject_id.title: Subject Id
subject_id.description: Scopes retrieval. Inferred from the message when omitted.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Conversation id; also the ephemeral upload namespace.

grade_ref.description: Set when the turn grades a saved assessment.

language.title: Language
language.description: Answer in this language. Outranks detection — pass it when the platform knows the learner's language.

response.title: Response
response.description: The composed reply, with inline citations.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Sources the reply cites, numbered to match its [n] markers.

ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope
ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every non-2xx response.

GradeReference.title: GradeReference
GradeReference.description: Points a grading turn at a saved assessment so its answer key is used.

assessment_id.title: Assessment Id
assessment_id.description: Fetches the stored rubric for this assessment.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when the model failed and output is a safe fallback.

lecture_id.title: Lecture Id
lecture_id.description: Platform lesson id; also the pipeline's lecture id.

source_uri.title: Source Uri
source_uri.description: file:// or s3:// URI of the lesson PDF.

subject_is_math.title: Subject Is Math
subject_is_math.description: Routes every page through vision; maths flattens under text extraction.

lesson_id.title: Lesson Id
lesson_id.description: Platform lesson id; resolved to source and subject.

LessonIngestionRequest.title: LessonIngestionRequest
LessonIngestionRequest.description: The platform's trigger: it knows the lesson, we resolve the rest.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when there is not yet enough graded work.

n.title: N
n.description: The inline marker this source is referenced by.

heading_path.title: Heading Path
heading_path.description: Where in the lesson, e.g. 'Unit 2 > Subtraction'.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description:
One source the reply cites, as structured data.

The reply text carries ``[n]`` markers; this is what each ``n`` refers to. A
client that renders the markers as badges needs the label and the page, and
should not have to parse them back out of the prose.

correct_answer.title: Correct Answer
correct_answer.description: Reference answer; used ahead of the syllabus when present.

Visual.title: Visual
Visual.description: A rendered study visual. Only the fields relevant to ``kind`` are present.

APIKeyHeader.description: Shared secret (AI_WEBHOOK_SHARED_SECRET). The platform backend sends this on every call; it is the same secret this service sends back.
APIKeyHeader.name: x-service-token
